title: correa reflexa var. nummulariifolia
intro: Correa reflexa var. nummulariifolia, commonly known as the Correa or Native Fuchsia, is a shrub native to eastern Australia, characterized by its glossy leaves and vibrant pink to red flowers. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Correa reflexa var. nummulariifolia include promoting tissue repair, reducing pain and inflammation, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its pharmacological effects.
